dedupe_keys.name: sliiders coastal exposure and socioeconomic scenarios

description: SLIIDERS is a Climate Impact Lab dataset for coastal climate-impact modelling. Version 1.1 describes 11,980 coastal regions with 18 socioeconomic variables and projects population, GDP and capital stock through 2100 under five Shared Socioeconomic Pathways and two economic growth models. Its generating repository describes coverage from 2000 to 2100, organized by coastal segment, elevation and scenario. The dataset can supply exposure and future-demand inputs for coastal flood-defence and adaptation simulations. Zenodo provides a compressed Zarr store, supporting Parquet inputs and source-code files; Python users can read the Zarr product through xarray. The data are free under CC BY-NC 4.0, while the generating code is MIT licensed. A limitation is the spatial aggregation and uncertainty in future socioeconomic assumptions. The repository also documents an approximation when reconciling elevation datums. SLIIDERS is the input family for the separate pyCIAM model draft. No existing catalogue record was established for this product. Neither data nor code archives were downloaded.
